info.name: 17 - Exercises
info.description: Endpoints to manage exercise library (create, approve, and query exercises with muscle group and equipment filters).

request.description:
### Endpoint Overview

Fetches a paginated list of exercises for the current gym with dynamic sorting and filtering.

---

### Available Domain Attributes & Filter Reference

| Attribute Name | Data Type | Filter Support | Description / Allowed Values |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Id` | `int` | Exact | Unique Identifier |
| `GymId` | `int` | Exact | Associated Gym ID |
| `Name` | `string` | Searchable | Exercise name (max 100 chars) |
| `Description` | `string` | Searchable | Exercise description (max 1000 chars) |
| `PrimaryMuscle` | `Enum (int)` | Exact | `0` = Chest, `1` = Back, `2` = Shoulders, `3` = Biceps, `4` = Triceps, `5` = Forearms, `6` = Abs, `7` = Quads, `8` = Hamstrings, `9` = Glutes, `10` = Calves, `11` = Traps, `12` = Lats, `13` = FullBody |
| `SecondaryMuscle` | `Enum (int)?` | Exact | Same values as PrimaryMuscle |
| `Equipment` | `Enum (int)?` | Exact | `0` = Barbell, `1` = Dumbbell, `2` = Machine, `3` = Cable, `4` = Bodyweight, `5` = Kettlebell, `6` = ResistanceBand, `7` = Other |
| `DifficultyLevel` | `Enum (int)` | Exact | `0` = Beginner, `1` = Intermediate, `2` = Advanced |
| `VideoUrl` | `string` | - | Tutorial video URL |
| `IsApproved` | `bool` | - | Approval status |
| `CreatedOn` | `DateTime` | Between | ISO creation date |
| `IsActive` | `bool` | Exact | Active status |

---

### Filter Usage Guide (For Request Body)

- **Exact Filters (`exactFilters`):** Pass attribute name with array of string/enum values. Example: `"exactFilters": { "PrimaryMuscle": ["0"] }`
- **Between Filters (`betweenFilters`):** Pass attribute name with `min` and `max`. Example: `"betweenFilters": { "CreatedOn": { "min": "2026-01-01", "max": "2026-12-31" } }`

---

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Member`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Fetches a single exercise by ID.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Member`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Creates a new exercise in the gym's library.

### Request Fields (`ExerciseCDTO`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | Max 100 characters |
| `description` | `string?` | No | Max 1000 characters |
| `primaryMuscle` | `Enum (int)` | Yes | `0`–`13` (see MuscleGroup enum) |
| `secondaryMuscle` | `Enum (int)?` | No | Same values as primaryMuscle |
| `equipment` | `Enum (int)?` | No | `0`–`7` (see ExerciseEquipment enum) |
| `difficultyLevel` | `Enum (int)` | Yes | `0` = Beginner, `1` = Intermediate, `2` = Advanced |
| `videoUrl` | `string?` | No | Max 1000 characters |

Returns `201 Created` with `Result<ExerciseRDTO>`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.
